environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TLS termination at the instance. No reverse proxy, no WAF. The application listens directly on port 8080, NLB forwards TCP/443 to TCP/8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured at infrastructure level. Cookie attributes set by application code only.
